module.purpose: This file provides Playwright end-to-end coverage for changing application and booking-page themes, verifying successful persistence and rendered theme state across dark, light, and system preferences.
module.summary: The file defines two groups of browser tests covering dashboard application themes and public booking-page themes. Each scenario creates and authenticates a user, opens appearance settings, selects a theme, submits the change, verifies a success toast, and checks the resulting HTML class. Application theme tests additionally verify the app-theme localStorage value, while system-theme tests compare rendering against the browser's prefers-color-scheme preference.
module.businessContext: Theme preferences affect the visual experience of authenticated users and public booking pages. Failures can leave users with incorrect appearance settings or inconsistent branded booking pages.

io: Interacts with appearance controls, waits for success toasts, reads HTML classes, and waits for page load state.
Navigates to the user's profile page and reloads it in the booking dark-theme test.
network: Creates a test user and performs API login through the users fixture.
Navigates to the appearance settings page and user profile pages.
env: Reads and asserts the browser localStorage value for app-theme.
Reads the browser prefers-color-scheme media query to determine the system theme.

moduleContractTests.when: await page.click('[data-testid="theme-dark"]'); await page.click('[data-testid="update-theme-btn"]'); await page.goto(`/${pro.username}`); await page.reload(); await page.waitForLoadState("domcontentloaded");

moduleContractTests.rationale: Pins booking-theme persistence and light-mode rendering on the public profile.

moduleContractTests.scenario: An authenticated user changes the booking page theme to system and views their profile.
moduleContractTests.rationale: Pins booking-page theme resolution against the browser system preference.
